hook: SCP-2851 is a very short file about a hallucinated voice that keeps urging people toward theft, sex, fights to the death and blood sacrifice, and that loses interest the moment it sees red. Pay attention to exactly what counts as exposure; the procedures are written with the document itself in mind. It takes about a minute to read.
whyItMatters:
It is a compact example of an anomaly that reaches out through its own paperwork, quietly placing the reader inside the containment problem. The countermeasure is just as small and practical, which gives the file its dry humor.

It also pairs a sinister premise with a toothless antagonist. The voice has no power to make anyone obey, and a splash of color is enough to flatter it into silence.
thingsToNotice:
Exposure comes from Wing 9 of Site-47 or from any SCP-2851 paperwork without red in it, which is why every copy must carry red text or a red background. The image at the top is captioned as an inoculation, so the page hands you the protective color before you read a word; by the article's own logic, anyone reading it stripped of that color is now hearing the voice.

The reaction to red is the punchline. The voice compliments the subject on their power, vitality and bloodlust and then leaves them alone for a while, so staff are encouraged to wear red and paint their homes and desks with it, an entire site's wardrobe organized around distracting one pushy hallucination.
